method.loudness: FFmpeg ebur128: momentary400ms and short-term3s K-weighted LUFS from original stereo;100ms reports. First2.9s short-term filter warm-up invalid. Values are trailing windows, not instantaneous hits.
method.analysis_pcm: Mono22050Hz float32 temporary in memory only; original unchanged. No model downloaded.
method.transient_proxy: Positive log spectral flux, FFT2048, hop220(9.977ms), equal weighting40-250/250-2000/2000-10000Hz; globally95th-percentile normalized. Local1s median+.8MAD and global.22 threshold;140ms greedy peak spacing; RMS>-48dBFS.
method.timing: FFT window centre time; approximately +/-50ms signal-localisation uncertainty, not musical beat validation.
method.density: Selected mixed-audio transient peaks per second in centred3s and10s windows. Vocal/consonant/string/percussion attacks may all contribute. NOT separated drum hits or BPM.
method.selection: 20/24/25/28/30s windows every0.5s, first/last5s gain plus trend correlation; silence excluded. Ranked candidates require human interpretation; crescendos need not increase monotonically.
method.strong_transient_proxy: Subset of detected local peaks with normalized flux strength>=1.0 (global flux95th percentile). One fixed threshold throughout the track. This is NOT drum identification. Sensitivity checked at0.8 and1.2.
method.nonfinite_loudness: Undefined values in digital silence and short-term warm-up are null in delivered curves; plotting does not infer audible energy there.
